churches.name: First Baptist Church Waco
churches.services: Sunday Bible Study (all ages); Sunday Worship (check website for times)

score_notes.scripture: CBF -- may not hold strict inerrancy.
score_notes.gender: CBF; historical women deacons; verify current practice.
score_notes.leadership: Male pastor; verify women in leadership roles.

churches.assessment: First Baptist Waco is CBF and BGCT-affiliated with pastor Matt Snowden (since 2010). The church has a historical legacy of allowing women deacons (dating back to B.H. Carroll's era) and commissioned women for missionary work. CBF affiliation means the church likely affirms women in ministry roles. Located in the Waco Baptist ecosystem alongside Baylor University. No explicit LGBTQ affirmation found, but CBF alignment and Waco's broader Baptist culture warrant caution for complementarian-minded men.

score_notes.gender: Male pastor. Complementarian — male leadership affirmed but not explicitly patriarchal.
